findings.remediation: Prove all four swap quadrants, the executed-not-requested basis, dust and partial-fill reverts, the executed-basis floor top-up, slippage and zero-sum settlement with specialist review. The four-quadrant proof, the reserve-drain regression and the solvency invariant are bound in the evidence index; the specialist review remains a maintainer-owned gate.
findings.summary: beforeSwapReturnDelta and afterSwapReturnDelta can bypass concentrated-liquidity swap math and move value across the specified and unspecified currencies. They are enabled deliberately because the mandatory quadrant-dependent quote-side fee cannot be collected without them on the two quadrants where the quote is the specified currency, and the reserve-funded floor top-up is paid as an after-swap delta on the unspecified currency.
